description: Tank duel campaign with real models served through SGLang: real rounds (the Node match process against the planner opponent) answered by any Hugging Face checkpoint (HONING_SGLANG_CHECKPOINT) through Honing's lettered readout, each release and candidate started on demand by SGLangPolicyEndpoints on HONING_SGLANG_GPUS; GEPA reflecting through a chat model on its own SGLang engine (HONING_SGLANG_CHAT_CHECKPOINT on HONING_SGLANG_CHAT_GPU); planner-teacher demonstrations for sft and sampled rollouts for grpo. The trainer is a stand-in that writes real, servable checkpoints (tests/fakes/serving.py) without training, so train moves exercise serving, not learning. Needs GPUs and the SGLang environment (SGLANG_PYTHON).
